acceptance: A real eligible operation exists at the claimed location; distinguish storefront, SAB and hybrid.
Staffing, customer access and signage meet applicable location rules; uncertainty remains Unknown.
Displayed name matches supported branding; no ranking-only service/location additions.
Names and core categories are consistent for equivalent operations, with documented real differences.
Street/building/floor/unit and postal details identify the actual branch.
Address display matches business eligibility and privacy requirements.
Pin/arrival instructions lead to the correct premises or entrance.
Suspected duplicate, former and closed listings are recorded and identity is resolved before proposing action.
Separate profiles meet their specific exception; do not assume every co-location is duplicate.
Verification, suspension, pending edits and access roles checked privately; public inference is insufficient.
Most appropriate available category describes the actual core business.
Categories match real offerings; do not infer unseen categories or add all competitor categories.
Customer-facing hours reflect this branch and applicable industry exceptions.
Applicable holiday, seasonal and service-specific hours are accurate.
Number is controlled by the business and routes accurately to this branch or clearly routed service.
Link lands on a working, relevant branch destination without wrong-store redirects.
Applicable action links preserve branch choice and lead to the correct offer or booking.
Accurate useful description without prohibited content, unsupported claims or keyword stuffing.
Applicable listings are accurate and available here; missing feature is not an automatic failure.
Relevant attributes are factual and help customers plan a visit.
Authentic current premises/entrance/interior/service imagery helps identify this store; no count minimum.
Any visible offers and updates are accurate and valid; absence alone is not a ranking failure.
Available customer questions/contact paths are checked; deprecated/unavailable features are excluded.
Count and rating are recorded accurately without universal pass cutoffs.
Recent activity is reported over disclosed windows; partial history is labeled a sample.
Useful respectful replies address material concerns; sample response denominator is explicit.
Recurring branch-specific problems are identified and routed to operations.
Requests are voluntary and neutral; no incentives, gating, fake reviews or pressured revisions.
Requests lead to the store the customer used; reviews are not pooled or reassigned artificially.
Comparable independent businesses selected per branch/intent; rationale and limitations recorded.
Reviews, categories, hours, services and media observations shown without fabricated values or causal claims.
Branded, generic, service and neighborhood demand is represented using actual business offerings.
Every branch, meaningful overlap zones and customer/commercial nodes are represented.
Coordinates, device, language, time, surface, depth and sponsored exclusions are documented.

evidence_required: Place ID/CID or verified entity evidence
acceptance: Each result maps to the correct branch; identical names are not conflated.

evidence_required: Local Pack/Maps captures or valid provider export
acceptance: Measured positions are surface-specific; Places discovery order is not reported as pack rank.
Top-three/observed-depth coverage computed using known valid observations.
Any-owned-branch visibility reported without summing siblings into double-counted coverage.
Overlap distinguished from harmful wrong-branch routing or organic page conflict; filtering is a hypothesis unless evidenced.
Changes compared using consistent origin/query/surface/depth and noted external/context changes.
Each branch maps to the intended canonical location page; no unrelated home/branch destination.
Customers and crawlers can discover and compare actual branches through usable links.
Priority location pages are accessible and intended for indexing; distinguish crawl blocks from noindex.
Actual indexing inspected with owner tools; site-search absence alone is not conclusive.
Branch pages do not accidentally canonicalize or redirect to siblings or the city hub.
Name, address/contact policy, phone, hours and services identify the correct branch.
Real entrance/parking/access/team/availability details help choose a store; no arbitrary uniqueness percentage.
Clear accurate service/branch context without keyword stuffing or forced word counts.
City hub, services and branch pages link usefully; no orphan stores or prescribed anchor ratios.
Pages serve distinct customer needs rather than low-value query variants funneling to the same destination.
Call, directions, forms, booking and branch selector work and keep the intended store.

evidence_required: Field data + lab checks as available
acceptance: Real bottlenecks are documented; URL/origin data and lab/field results remain distinct.
Each actual branch has an appropriate distinct entity/URL; no fabricated premises or identifiers.
Syntax, semantic accuracy and feature eligibility reported separately; unsupported types are not parse failures.
No self-serving review-star promises or copied third-party aggregate stars treated as eligible.
Relevant local-language content is useful; hreflang checked only when alternate-language/region pages exist.
Audit relevant maps, local and industry platforms; do not universally require US directories.
Normalize phone/address formatting while preserving unit, building and routing differences.
Listing refers to the correct branch; central business data is not substituted indiscriminately.
Material former or duplicate identities documented with correction path.
Assess genuine community, trade and editorial relevance; avoid bulk listing/link quotas.
Stable IDs join GBP, page, analytics and CRM without changing public names.
Branch-specific tracking works and clean canonical destinations are retained.
Forms/bookings/calls preserve branch and source; no personal data in tracking URLs.
Clicks, call interactions, qualified leads, completed bookings and visits remain distinct.
Compare matched windows and seasonality; record missing data and changes in definitions.
Business retains appropriate control; changes have an assigned owner and recovery evidence.
Each proposed/final change has branch scope, responsible role and observable acceptance check.
Record actual brand/branch mentions, cited URLs and wrong-store facts without inferring answers from web search.
Audit discoverability and factual clarity; training preferences are not automatically search eligibility failures.
